description: Returns the most recent Preventionlabs report for a verified website, how long ago it ran, and how many runs are left. Costs no run. Use it to reread a result, or to check what's left before deciding whether to run a new report. It shows the site as it was then, not now.

site.description: The website, e.g. example.com. Leave empty when the account has only one verified site.

name: latest_report
title: Read the latest report
